review.mathematicalCheck: Expanding gives \(x^2=4+2\sqrt3\) and \(y^2=4-2\sqrt3\), whose sum is 8. Independently, \(x+y=2\sqrt3\) and \(xy=2\), so the retained shortcut gives \(12-4=8\). Both arguments are sufficient.
